sentences.text:
Mr. Debangan Bhattacharya, Mr. Ranjit Singh, Ms. Tutul Das, Mr. Amar Singh, Mr. Pranit Biswas,
Mr. Gunjan Jain, Mr. Mehiul Islam, Ms. Mohona Bandyopadhyay, ...for the petitioner.
This is an application wherein petitioner has prayed for quashing of the G.R. Case No. 2928 of 2021 presently pending before learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, 1st Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, 1st Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The allegations levelled in the FIR inter alia to the effect that the petitioner herein is working as a Branch Manager of the M/s. Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited.

entities.text: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The opposite party herein took loan for purchasing a vehicle and he was regularly paying of the instalments due and/or payable to the petitioner herein.

However, the petitioner along with other agents of the M/s. Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited in a gross illegal manner has forcefully taken possession of the vehicle of the opposite party no. 2.

entities.text: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After completion of investigation, police submitted charge- sheet on 31st August 2022 under Section 420/406 of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioner.

Being aggrieved by the aforesaid proceeding, learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the opposite party no. 2 is a habitual defaulter in payment of installments in respect of loan amount and in an attempt to conceal his own misconduct he has deliberately framed a civil dispute as a criminal proceeding and filed instant complaint.

Referring several authorities he submits that due to default in payment of instalments, if the vehicle is seized by the Financier, no criminal action can be taken against him as he is deemed to be the owner of the vehicle until last installment is paid.

He further submits that it is apparent from the demand notice dated 07.04.2021 that prior to the lodging of the complaint the opposite party herein was called upon to pay a sum of Rs. 32,89,421.00/- which the complainant failed to pay in terms of the agreement.

Therefore, he submits that the continuance of the instant proceeding will be mere abuse of the process of the Court and ingredients of the office alleged in the complaint is conspicuously absent in the instant case.
Having heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner, the application is admitted.

Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the application upon the opposite party no. 1 through the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and also upon the opposite party no. 2 through speed post intimating the next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

Let the matter be listed under heading " To Be Mentioned"

Case no. 2928 of 2021presently pending before learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, 1st Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur is hereby stayed for twelve weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, duly applied for, be given to the parties upon compliance of all requisite formalities.
( Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J. )
